title: AI detector failure messages must describe the outcome
answers: Why does an AI detector failure say the model provider is unreachable?
What should owners see when an AI detector cannot complete a check?
Should detector failure notifications recommend reviewing alert settings?
body:
Symptom: An alert owner sees a provider failure and reassurance that their settings are correct even though neither was established.
Root cause: products/alerts/backend/judge/contract.py:LLM_DETECTOR_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE represents rollout lookup failures, busy model-call slots, transport failures, and unreadable model replies with one error code.
Fix pattern: Describe the incomplete check without asserting a cause or settings validity; keep posthog/tasks/alerts/utils.py:send_notifications_for_errors and posthog/temporal/alerts/activities.py:dispatch_alert_error_in_app_notifications aligned with that contract.
Constraints: Apply this wording and omission of settings-review advice to LLM_DETECTOR_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_CODE; other evaluation errors retain their separate settings-review behavior.
applies: Owner-facing check history, email, and in-app messaging for unavailable AI detector checks.
